channel.title: Celestine — Art, Music & Film News
channel.description: What's happening right now across art, music, and film.

item.title: Ryu Jun Yeol, Jung Ho Yeon, Hong Kyung, And More Confirmed To Star In New Mystery Thriller Drama
item.description: Netflix announced the star-studded cast, including Ryu Jun Yeol and Jung Ho Yeon, for its upcoming mystery thriller drama "Outback."

item.title: ‘Stuffed’ Review: Jodie Comer and Harry Melling Sing the Body Eccentric in an Odd, and Oddly Touching, Taxidermy Musical
item.description: Jodie Comer and Harry Melling star in "Stuffed," a peculiar new taxidermy musical that premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival.

item.title: Artists Reflect on 9/11 and the Wounds of the “War on Terror”
item.description: Artists including Shahzia Sikander, Wafaa Bilal, and Rina Banerjee reflect on the trauma of 9/11 and the subsequent rise of Islamophobia and surveillance.

item.title: Anna Ortiz Traverses the Multiple Realities of the Borderlands
item.description: Artist Anna Ortiz's new exhibition explores the mythic realities and multiple dimensions of the U.S.-Mexico borderlands.

item.title: N.O.R.E. Sued for Sexual Assault
item.description: Rapper and media personality N.O.R.E. has been sued for a sexual assault allegedly committed at a Manhattan nightclub in 1999.

item.title: ‘EA Sports FC 27’ soundtrack to feature Royal Blood, The Strokes and more
item.description: The upcoming video game *EA Sports FC 27* will feature a soundtrack headlined by The Strokes, Royal Blood, and several other artists.

item.title: The Criterion Collection Just Got Its First Physical Outpost in Toronto
item.description: Toronto's newly opened Cinema Cellar has become the Criterion Collection's very first physical retail outpost.

item.title: Republicans' Midterm Convention Is Trumpapalooza, But Few Mention His War in Iran
item.description: At their Dallas midterm convention focused entirely on Donald Trump, Republican attendees notably avoided discussing his ongoing war in Iran.

item.title: Public School Spring 2027 Menswear
item.description: Public School debuted its Spring 2027 menswear collection.

item.title: Bayeux Tapestry Exhibition Opens at British Museum
item.description: The British Museum has opened its long-awaited and eagerly anticipated blockbuster exhibition featuring the historic Bayeux Tapestry.

item.title: Rakuten Viki’s K-Drama Day Returns For The Fourth Year: Celebrate With Free Shows, Special Prizes, Talent Exclusives, And More
item.description: Rakuten Viki has launched its fourth annual K-Drama Day, running from September 25 through October 1 with free shows, prizes, and exclusive content.

item.title: xikers Reveals Comeback Date With Teaser For “ROUTE ZERO : The CALLING”
item.description: Boy group xikers announced their upcoming return by releasing a teaser for their eighth mini-album, "ROUTE ZERO : The CALLING."

item.title: Watch: CRAVITY Announces Comeback With Teaser For New EP “sonorous”
item.description: K-pop group CRAVITY announced their upcoming comeback by releasing a teaser video for their new mini album, "sonorous," set to drop on September 30.

item.title: Watch: ENHYPEN Takes 7th Win And Triple Crown For “Bloody Paradise” On “M Countdown”; Performances By EVAN, &TEAM, And More
item.description: ENHYPEN secured their seventh music show win and a triple crown for "Bloody Paradise" on the September 10 episode of "M Countdown."

item.title: Jung Min Ah And Dong Ha’s Lives Collide Over Fashion And A Hidden Family Secret In “Mission: Mompossible”
item.description: The new daily drama "Mission: Mompossible" released a poster previewing the intertwined lives and hidden family secrets of two vastly different mothers and their children.

item.title: France Unveils Shortlist of Five Films for the International Oscar Race, From ‘Minotaur’ to ‘De Gaulle’ and ‘Iron Boy’
item.description: France announced a five-film shortlist featuring "Minotaur" and "The Battle of De Gaulle" to represent the nation in the international Oscar race.

item.title: Paul Walker’s Brother Says AI Could Bring Actor Back for Final ‘Fast and Furious’ Movie but ‘I Would Not Be Interested in Doing That’
item.description: Paul Walker’s brother rejected the idea of using artificial intelligence to resurrect the late actor's character for the final "Fast and Furious" film.

item.title: ‘Hawaii Five-O’ Movie in the Works From ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ Director Destin Daniel Cretton
item.description: Paramount is developing a "Hawaii Five-O" feature film directed by Destin Daniel Cretton and written by Chris Bremner.

item.title: Andrew Scott to Receive Mill Valley Film Festival’s Acting Award for ‘Elsinore’ (EXCLUSIVE)
item.description: Andrew Scott will receive the Mill Valley Film Festival’s Acting Award for his starring role in the upcoming drama "Elsinore."

item.title: Gaza Doc ‘NAZA,’ From ‘No Other Land’ Directors, Earns Record-Breaking 24.5-Minute Venice Ovation as Producer Jonathan Glazer Leads Applause
item.description: The Gaza documentary “NAZA” broke Venice Film Festival records with a massive 24.5-minute standing ovation led by producer Jonathan Glazer.
